name: debuff
description: Inspect, build, test and play a debuff game
long_description: Connects Claude to a 2D web game built with debuff. Claude can read the project, start the game headless or attach to the tab you have open under `debuff dev`, send input, step time, take captures, tune params, run scenarios and read explained runtime errors.

project.title: Game project
project.description: The folder of your debuff game (the one with package.json)
